mapper.select: SELECT c.product_id, p.name, p.price, p.stock, p.status, c.quantity FROM cart_item c JOIN product p ON p.id=c.product_id WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.product_id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND product_id=#{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT product_id,quantity FROM cart_item WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY product_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND product_id IN #{id}
